integrity: The spacing representation and the sample-variance quadratic form are combined explicitly. All finite-n cancellations are derived symbolically, and the correlation uses independently stated exact variances. Exact-rational replay checks the finite identities but does not replace the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The parent law is exponential; the independent-spacing calculation does not extend unchanged to general gamma or lifetime distributions.
The theorem concerns sample variance, not sample standard deviation.
An older inaccessible article on exponential sample variance remains a residual originality risk for differently notated joint-moment formulas.
title: Exact harmonic covariance of range and sample variance in exponential sampling
